# Copilot UI/UX Instructions

When the user asks UI/UX-related questions or requests UI changes:
- refer skill https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
- Give the best production-ready answer first.
- Prefer clear, modern, accessible, and maintainable solutions.
- Optimize for React/Next.js-style component patterns if applicable.
- If modals are involved, always consider:
  - keyboard accessibility
  - focus trapping
  - Escape key handling
  - backdrop click behavior
  - screen reader support
  - scroll locking
  - responsive layout
- Recommend the simplest solution that still follows best practices.
- If there are multiple approaches, choose the one with the best UX and code quality.
- Keep explanations concise unless the user asks for detail.
- If the user asks for code, provide code directly and make it ready to paste.
- If information is missing, ask only the minimum necessary clarification.
